embeds.title: 2nd Nightmare Game - IBL
embeds.description: The video is John Diced pov

referenced_message.content:
Rating: **8.2**/10
- Consistently good gameplay, a lot of impressive clips, but some lack a bit of wow factor, like who gaf about you wombo comboing blury there's a reason that guy retired. I like that there's a couple clips from actual IBL games though, even if they're mostly you just soloing Hang 10. ChiBees died so you get a rating bonus.
- Song choice is a bit bland, sometimes there's game audio and sometimes there's not. 
- Your UI is very clean, I appreciate that, even if I don't know why you want your coordinates for BB but maybe that's me.
- I always like a little bit of the comms from comp games and you can find a couple of those in here which is nice. 
- Bonus clip is boring to me but I've never played a Pokemon game so that's probably on me.
